verdict.rationale: Stripe Billing documents a Subscriptions API for creating subscriptions and an official MCP server that lets AI agents interact with the Stripe API, so an agent has a first-party programmatic surface. Proration previews imply plan changes, but applying credits and scoped or restricted agent permissions are not evidenced. Missing for 10: documented credit/balance application via API, documented plan-change operation, scoped/restricted permissions for agent access, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven billing operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can operate my billing — create a subscription, apply a credit, change a plan — through a programmatic surface with scoped permissions

citations.quote: Create a new subscription in the Dashboard or with the Subscriptions API.
Let your AI agents interact with the Stripe API by using our MCP server.
You can preview a proration to view the amount before applying the changes.
